issues.detail: The Greek word 'ζηλοι' (zēloi) in this context refers to 'jealousy/envy' or 'strife', but the Vietnamese translation 'sự tranh cạnh' (competition/rivalry) is used twice to translate two different Greek words: 'ζηλοι' and 'εριθειαι'. Furthermore, 'εριθειαι' (eritheiai) specifically refers to 'ambition' or 'selfish ambition', which is lost in the repetition of 'tranh cạnh'.
The Greek word 'φυσιωσεις' (physiōseis) refers to 'faces/countenances' or 'expressions'. The Vietnamese translation omits this concept entirely.
